metadata.source: Congressional District Health Dashboard, Department of Population Health, NYU Langone Health.
metadata.alignmentMethod: Exactly the original morph viewer fit: least-squares uniform scale and translation after a y flip, using original district-centroid correspondences. Never recomputed after reassignment.
metadata.geometry: Raw aligned source centers and original drawn radius are retained exactly. Integer axial coordinates describe topology; source rounding is not snapped away.
metadata.topology: Adjacency and footprint roughness use neighboring grid cells. The original drawn hex radius is smaller than the grid radius, leaving intentional visual gutters.

metadata.source: Census cb_2024_us_cd119_20m geometry and map_neighbors from the existing morph viewer hexmap_data.js; 435 congressional districts plus DC.
metadata.projection: d3.geoAlbersUsa() with unchanged defaults, exactly as the morph comparison viewer; Alaska and Hawaii retain the existing projected inset positions.
metadata.coordinateSystem: Projected screen units; x right, y down. Responsive SVG display does not change these coordinates.
metadata.representativePoint: d3.geoPath(projection).centroid(feature), including the same projected multipart geometry as the morph viewer.
metadata.adjacency: Existing map_neighbors: shared Census boundary segment, not corner-only contact. No inferred water connections.
metadata.adaptation: The mainland generator uses the largest dissolved original exterior; detached small offshore rings and interior holes are not imposed as layout constraints. All original district rings remain visible in the reference map and all 436 district labels are retained. Alaska (1) and Hawaii (2) are handled as explicit inset placement adaptations, not a single contiguous 436-region McNeill run.
metadata.importedHexLayoutUsage: Generated-layout mode does not use NYU positions. Fixed-NYU mode reuses their exact aligned cells and drawn radius, then changes only district assignments.
